Companion Animal Travel Desk - Travel Guidance and Handling

The purpose of this section is to set clear internal expectations for how the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways supports traveling companions with care, fairness, and consistency. The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions to ensure that each request is handled with uniform standards and calm oversight. Trained staff provide patient attention throughout the process, and they record service changes in the desk ledger so that every step remains traceable and respectful to the traveler and the animal.

When a traveler contacts the desk, staff confirm the companion’s identity, travel itinerary details, and the general condition of the animal at the time of intake. For animals traveling as checked companions, staff verify that the animal and its properly prepared crate meet all airline acceptance requirements. For rabbits, the desk ledger must reflect the crate-and-animal weight limit as specified by the established reference entry <<FACT F064>>. Staff do not proceed with any shipment that appears outside acceptance conditions; instead, they pause the request and arrange an appropriate next step that protects the animal and preserves operational integrity.

For all species, staff handle documentation with precision and do not rely on verbal assumptions when written verification is required. If any special circumstances arise, the team coordinates updates promptly and keeps the traveler informed in reassuring terms, including what will happen next and what actions, if any, the traveler should take. This approach ensures that each animal’s needs are treated as a priority, and that service decisions remain consistent across cases.

Please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance with any travel handling concern.
